data.rationale: The proposal gets the core flow right (Attractions & Tickets, city, keyword, search, sort, open a result) and names city, keyword and sort as parameters, but it leaves out the final action (view nearby or add to favorites) as a parameter and step, and it frames sort as only lowest price or top rated. It is concrete enough to automate the search and sort, but the post-open action is missing.
